get.description:
Fetches correlated events from dispatch decisions, circuit breaker transitions, guardrail outcomes, and anomaly alerts. Events are interleaved by timestamp and include trace IDs and rationale payloads for decision context. Supports cursor-based pagination for efficient scrolling through large result sets, as well as traditional offset pagination.

**Latency SLA:** Typical queries (single campaign, default limit) target sub-100ms server-side response time. Queries spanning large time ranges or using complex filter combinations may take longer.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by event type. Accepts canonical type names (dispatch, circuit_breaker, anomaly_alert, guardrail_outcome, operator_action) or convenience aliases (routing → dispatch, circuit-breaker/cb → circuit_breaker, anomaly/anomaly-alert → anomaly_alert, guardrail/guardrail-outcome → guardrail_outcome). Aliases are normalized server-side to their canonical form. Matching is case-insensitive. When unset and campaignId is set, only dispatch events are returned (CB and anomaly excluded as they have no campaign concept).

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: Filter by campaign ID. When set, dispatch events are scoped to this campaign; CB and anomaly events are excluded unless type is explicitly specified

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter circuit breaker events by provider. Also resolved to agentIds for dispatch filtering when agentId is not specified

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: Filter dispatch events by agent ID. Overrides provider filter when specified

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Filter events after this ISO timestamp

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Filter events before this ISO timestamp

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Base64-encoded pagination cursor for cursor-based pagination. When provided, offset is ignored. Obtain from the next_cursor field in a previous response.

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.description: Filter events by trace ID. Returns all events sharing the same trace context.

parameters.name: dispatchId
parameters.description: Filter events by dispatch ID. Returns the dispatch event and all correlated events (circuit breaker, guardrail, anomaly) for that dispatch.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Alias for the type parameter. Accepts the same canonical types and aliases as type. Values are normalized server-side: routing → dispatch, circuit-breaker/cb → circuit_breaker, anomaly/anomaly-alert → anomaly_alert, guardrail/guardrail-outcome → guardrail_outcome. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Alias for the since parameter. Filter events after this ISO timestamp.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Alias for the until parameter. Filter events before this ISO timestamp.

get.description:
Opens a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream that emits real-time operator steering actions (replay, steer, pause, weight override). Supports optional filtering by action type and correlation ID. Clients can reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header to replay missed events since their last received event.

**Event format:** Each event uses the `steering:action` event type with a JSON data payload. The `id` field is the event timestamp (ISO 8601) for reconnection support. A keepalive comment (`: keepalive`) is sent every 15 seconds to prevent connection timeouts.

**Connection lifecycle:** The connection remains open indefinitely. Clients should handle reconnection on disconnect. The server disables socket and response timeouts for this endpoint.

parameters.name: actionType
parameters.description: Filter events to only those matching this action type

parameters.name: correlationId
parameters.description: Filter events to only those matching this correlation ID (matches against dispatchId, traceId, or campaignId)

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last received event. When provided, the server replays missed operator_action events after this timestamp before switching to live streaming. Up to 100 historical events are replayed.

200.description: SSE event stream opened successfully. Events are sent as `steering:action` typed SSE messages.

schema.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each event has the format:

id: <ISO timestamp>
event: steering:action
data: <JSON payload>

Keepalive comments (`: keepalive`) are sent every 15 seconds.

post.summary: Replay a dispatch by correlation ID
post.description:
Replays a previous dispatch identified by its correlation ID, optionally redirecting to a different agent or provider. The replay creates a new dispatch record based on the source dispatch's parameters. Requires operator role with `dispatch_replay` permission.

**Idempotency:** Every request must include an idempotency key (via `Idempotency-Key`, `X-Idempotency-Key`, or `X-Action-ID` header, or `actionId`/`idempotencyKey` in the request body). Duplicate requests with the same key return the original response without creating a new dispatch.

**Side effects:** On success, the replay is recorded in the operator audit log, emitted as an `operator:action` event on the EventBus (visible in the steering SSE stream), and broadcast to WebSocket subscribers.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Idempotency key for this replay action. Alternatively use `X-Idempotency-Key` or `X-Action-ID` headers, or include `actionId` in the request body.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID (dispatch ID, trace ID, or campaign ID) of the source dispatch to replay

targetAgent.description: Optional agent ID to redirect the replay to. Must be a valid registered agent. When omitted, the original agent is used.

targetProvider.description: Optional provider name to redirect the replay to. Must be a valid provider. When set without targetAgent, the agent matching this provider is selected.

actionId.description: Alternative to the Idempotency-Key header. Provides the idempotency key in the request body.

idempotencyKey.description: Alternative field name for actionId. Provides the idempotency key in the request body.

projectId.description: Project ID for scoping the audit log entry. Defaults to 'default'.

200.description: Replay completed successfully. Returns the same response for idempotent retries.

actionId.description: The idempotency key used for this action

correlationId.description: The correlation ID that was replayed

sourceDispatchId.description: The original dispatch ID that was replayed

replayDispatchId.description: The newly created dispatch ID from the replay

operatorId.description: The operator who initiated the replay

replayTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the replay was executed

400.description: Invalid request — missing idempotency key, invalid JSON, missing correlationId, or invalid targetAgent/targetProvider

403.description: Forbidden — operator role with dispatch_replay permission required

404.description: Dispatch not found for the given correlation ID

500.description: Server error — dispatch log or operator action store not available, or replay dispatch creation failed
